title: Numeric polar scatter
intent: Compare independent observations by angular position and radial magnitude.

source.title: Apache ECharts Polar Scatter Punch Card

ai.create: Create fourteen equally sized points over continuous zero-to-three-hundred-sixty-degree angle and zero-to-one-hundred radius domains.
ai.maintain: Update radial values while preserving angles, fixed domains, responsive layout, stable observation keys, and constant symbol size.
